title: CV Tutorial chapters 22–28 — claim/source register
scope: Primary papers and official docs. Figures and runnable samples are illustrative (教学示意), not benchmarks. No dataset-level mIoU/PQ numbers are asserted here.

entries.claim: FCN replaces the classifier's fully connected layers with convolutions to emit dense per-pixel predictions, but retains downsampling so the prediction is coarse before upsampling
entries.caveat: The ~1/32 output stride is the VGG-based FCN example, not a universal constant

entries.claim: Dilated/atrous convolution keeps the parameter count fixed while the effective kernel grows as k_eff = k + (k-1)(d-1)
entries.caveat: Still cross-correlation (no kernel flip); padding must equal the dilation rate to keep output size

entries.claim: DeepLab v3 ASPP defaults to parallel 1x1, multiple dilation rates (commonly 6/12/18) and a global-average-pooling branch, concatenated and fused by 1x1 conv
entries.caveat: Rate set and output channels are implementation/crop-size choices; gridding motivates hybrid rates

entries.claim: SegNet decodes with pooling indices; PSPNet uses a pyramid pooling module over 1x1/2x2/3x3/6x6 grids; DeepLab v3+ adds a light decoder over ASPP
entries.caveat: Comparisons are qualitative here; CRF post-processing belongs to DeepLab v1/v2 and was dropped by v3

entries.claim: Panoptic segmentation assigns every pixel a class label plus an instance id for countable things, with stuff carrying only a class label and no overlaps
entries.caveat: Merging instance and semantic outputs needs a fusion/dedup step; it is not a plain union

entries.claim: Panoptic Quality PQ = SQ x RQ, with SQ the mean IoU over true positives and RQ = TP / (TP + 0.5*FP + 0.5*FN); a predicted/gt segment is a TP only if class matches and IoU > 0.5
entries.caveat: Threshold, empty-segment handling and stuff scoring are part of the protocol; the page's PQ numbers are toy 教学示意

entries.claim: SAM is promptable (points/boxes/masks), uses a heavy image encoder, a light prompt encoder and a light mask decoder, and returns multiple ambiguity-aware masks
entries.caveat: Class-agnostic: it does not output class names; prompt-free use requires an automatic mask-generation pass

entries.claim: SA-1B is reported as ~11M images and ~1.1B masks
entries.caveat: Paper-reported dataset scale; not recomputed here
